name: Bigfoot's Hemp Milk Latte

pairing.name: Bigfoot
pairing.reason: Earthy, nutty, and elusive. Best enjoyed while trekking through the Cascades.

description: A creamy, nutty alternative for those who want a plant-based boost without the typical almond or oat profile.
ingredients: 2 shots of espresso (or 1/2 cup strong brewed coffee)
instructions: Brew your espresso and pour into a large mug.
Heat the hemp milk until steaming (do not boil).
Froth and pour over the coffee.
Add a tiny pinch of salt to enhance the nuttiness.

name: Ceremonial Green Matcha

pairing.name: Tako nyūdō
pairing.reason: A disciplined drink for a scholarly yōkai. Keeps the mind sharp for ancient scrolls.

description: A vibrant, whisked tea that provides a calm, focused energy perfect for podcast listening.
instructions: Sift the matcha into a bowl.
Whisk in a 'W' motion until frothy.
vibe: The Mind Cleanser. Add hemp milk for a creamy treat (Odd Bob variant).

name: Verdant Bulleit Sour

pairing.name: Ahuizotl
pairing.reason: Has a bite like a mackinaw. The green hue matches the murky depths of the water-monkey's home.

description: A herbaceous twist on the classic whiskey sour, bringing a botanical edge to the bite of Bulleit Bourbon.
instructions: Prepare the Matcha: Create your matcha paste in a small bowl as described below.
Matcha Paste: Whisk 1 tsp matcha powder with 1 tsp hot water until smooth.
Combine: Add the bourbon, lemon juice, simple syrup, and matcha paste to a shaker.
The Foam (Optional): If using an egg white, perform a "dry shake" (shaking all ingredients without ice) for 15 seconds to build a thick foam.
Chill: Add ice to the shaker and shake vigorously for another 10–15 seconds until the tin is frosted.
Fine Strain: Double strain through a fine-mesh Hawthorne strainer into a chilled rocks glass or coupe. The fine mesh is crucial to catch any tiny matcha particulates.
vibe: Mist rising over a mossy riverbank.

name: Saoirse’s Puca Punch

pairing.name: Soercia
pairing.reason: A mischievous blend that changes color with a squeeze of lime—just like a shapeshifter.

description: A shimmering, violet-hued botanical tea that’s as unpredictable as an Irish Puca.
ingredients: 1 cup Butterfly Pea Flower tea (brewed and chilled)
A squeeze of fresh lime juice
instructions: Brew the pea flower tea until it is a deep, dark blue.
Fill a tall glass with ice and pour in the tea.
Stir in the lime juice and watch the drink turn from deep blue to bright purple.
Add a pinch of luster dust for that supernatural shimmer.
